s: The ever-increasing use and evolution of technology, including cloud-based computing and AI, creates opportunities for the unintentional dissemination or intentional destruction or modification of confidential information stored in our, or our third-party providers’ systems, portable media or storage devices.

Moreover, as cyber-attacks increase in frequency and magnitude, including by actors using AI, we may be unable to obtain cybersecurity insurance in amounts and on terms we view as appropriate for our operations.
